app.name: Nistta Café
app.tagline: Order for pickup or dine-in — menu, kitchen queue, and checkout on one stack.

whatsapp.messageTemplate: Hi — I'm interested in *{{title}}* (SKU: {{sku}}). Vendor: {{vendor}}. Page: {{url}}

items.label: WhatsApp
items.messageTemplate: Hi — I’m browsing {{url}} and would like help.

cards.title: Free shipping
cards.body: Orders over INR 1,999 ship free this week — GST invoice included.

cards.title: Vendor tools
cards.body: Preview storefront layout and SKUs before you publish.

cards.title: Admin
cards.body: Lookups and directory screens stay JSON-driven — extend packs without redeploying the host.

cards.title: Sponsored picks
cards.body: Choose which catalogue products appear in the storefront right rail as sponsored vendor placements.

notificationBar.message: Free shipping over INR 1,999 · New festival collections live now · GST-ready invoices for every order

footer.blurb: Multi-vertical commerce (sarees, groceries, LPG) — configuration-driven UI.

sections.message: Available · Need help? Chat on WhatsApp · 100% quality-checked dispatch

sections.title: Discover sarees
sections.subtitle: Browse GST-linked vendors, save to cart, and checkout with the same calm layout as leading storefront landings — copy and sections stay in this JSON file.
sections.trustLine: Secure guest browse · Vendor onboarding · One account for future verticals

items.title: Configuration-first
items.body: Forms, validation, and layout live in JSON consumed by @webkitfxv2/core-engine.

items.title: Roadmap
items.body: Same shell supports groceries and gas-cylinder distribution — swap form packs per vertical.

items.title: Guests welcome
items.body: Browse and checkout flows can start as guest; upgrade to a full profile anytime.

login.title: Login
login.lede: Sign in with the email and password for your account. Your role (shopper or vendor) is determined from that account.

welcome.headline: Welcome
welcome.intro: Order for pickup, dine-in, or from your table — manage your menu and kitchen from the same place.

highlights.title: Pickup & dine-in
highlights.body: Choose service mode at checkout; orders go straight to the kitchen queue.

highlights.title: Table QR menu
highlights.body: Guests scan a table code to browse and order without installing an app.

highlights.title: Saved cart
highlights.body: Shoppers sign in to keep cart lines on the server for this café.

vendorSignup.title: Vendor registration
vendorSignup.lede: Create portal credentials first (login name + password), then business, GST, address, and contact rows — those credentials are what you will use on Sign in.

shopperSignup.title: Shopper profile
shopperSignup.lede: Set portal login name and password, then profile and delivery details — reuse them on Sign in.

settings.title: Settings
settings.body: Preference screens will be driven by JSON packs per vertical (sarees, groceries, LPG) — wire forms here the same way as signup.

support.title: Help centre
support.body: Support content and ticketing will load from your operations JSON — no hardcoded FAQs in the app bundle.

legalPrivacy.title: Privacy
legalPrivacy.body: Privacy policy text will be supplied as markdown or HTML from configuration per tenant.

legalTerms.title: Terms of use
legalTerms.body: Terms will be versioned in configuration alongside rollout of groceries and LPG modules.

cart.title: Your cart
cart.body: Items stay on this device until checkout is connected to your commerce API. Quantities update below.
cart.emptyHint: Browse the catalogue and use Add to cart on a product page.

accountProfile.title: Your profile
accountProfile.body: You are signed in with the account below. Details combine your registration data and the last successful sign-in.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.body: Saved items and lists will appear here once the catalogue pack is wired.

orders.title: Orders
orders.body: Order history and tracking will load from your commerce services — this route is a placeholder.

communication.title: Communication
communication.body: Messages, alerts, and announcements will be driven from your notifications configuration — placeholder for now.

search.title: Search menu
search.body: Find dishes by name, menu section, and attributes vendors set on café items (dietary, spice level, course, and more). Results are limited to this café menu.
search.noResults: No menu items matched your search.
search.noAttributesHint: No filterable menu attributes are configured yet. Search by dish name or menu section, or ask an admin to add filterable attributes in Commerce.Api.

adminVendors.title: Vendors
adminVendors.body: Vendor master and lifecycle management screens are configuration-driven placeholders.

adminShoppers.title: Shoppers
adminShoppers.body: Shopper directory and lifecycle screens are configuration-driven placeholders.

adminOrders.title: Orders
adminOrders.body: Order operations, workflows, and exception handling screens are configuration-driven placeholders.
